key_insight: AnyScene introduces a unified occupancy-guided generation framework that enables highly controllable, high-fidelity driving-scene synthesis from arbitrary BEV (bird’s-eye-view) layouts and without reliance on a specific reference video frame, unlocking flexible scenario creation anywhere.
problem_solved: Existing occupancy-guided scene generators use shallow conditioning and reference-frame-dependent synthesis, which prevents fine-grained control from arbitrary BEV plans and limits scalability for simulating rare or safety-critical driving scenarios.
method: Unified occupancy-conditioned pipeline that decouples scene layout (BEV) from reference-frame constraints, enabling synthesis from arbitrary BEV inputs.
Deeper conditioning mechanisms (e.g., richer cross-modal conditioning across occupancy, semantics and camera views) to achieve fine-grained control over objects, motion, and layout.
Reference-frame-independent temporal synthesis and consistency strategies to produce scalable, multi-frame driving scenes suitable for simulation and data augmentation.
impact: AnyScene makes it practical to generate diverse, controllable synthetic driving data for training and testing autonomous driving systems—helping address long-tail, safety-critical scenarios and accelerating robust model development and evaluation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: BEV/layout -> occupancy conditioning -> generative module -> multi-view rendered frames (showing decoupling from reference frame)
Before/after control grid: same scene with varied BEV inputs (object placements, speeds, lane changes) to show fine-grained controllability
Temporal consistency visualization: short video strip or frame sequence demonstrating reference-frame-independent synthesis across time
Comparison chart: fidelity & controllability metrics vs. prior occupancy-guided and reference-frame-dependent methods
paper_title: AnyScene: Towards Highly Controllable Driving Scene Generation at Anywhere and Beyond
paper_authors: Haiming Zhang, Junfei Zhou, Feng Jiang, Jingzhong Li, Zhenglong Guo
